description: Multi-language support (i18n/l10n). Use when a task touches a translation file or a user-facing string in a product that ships more than one language: adding a language or key, extracting strings, vue-i18n/nestjs-i18n/go-i18n, locale formatting, translated data (enums, emails, PDFs), locale routing, hreflang, RTL. Its core failure is a key that reaches one pack and not the others.
